description.value: Pacific Sands Beach Resort is a beachfront resort on Cox Bay in Tofino, BC, with over 50 years of operation and 122 suites and beach houses ranging from studios to a four-bedroom property. Rated #1 hotel in Tofino on TripAdvisor, it offers surf-in/surf-out access to what the resort calls Canada's top-rated surfing beach, with old-growth rainforest and coastal trails immediately accessible. All suites include fully equipped kitchens, making self-catering easy for touring cyclists using Tofino as a base.
